The CBOR root map contains a payload/file/hash path chosen by the input.
A one-element hash array satisfies the caller's non-empty-array check.
Because the first hash element is not an array, the whole one-element array is treated as a single hash tuple.
The hash parser assumes any hash tuple array has the required pair layout after only the caller's >= 1 check.
Fetching element 1 from a one-element CBOR array reaches libcbor with an out-of-range index and triggers the reported heap-buffer-overflow read.
